display.note: 96 px art at today's hero height (user 2026-10-11: "96. 같은 키. 선명해야 뭐가 보이지")

proportions.note: crown to chin about 40% of the height, about 2.5 heads (measured on the 도깨비의세계 reference)

style.outline: 1 px, outer silhouette dark; inner lines the darkest tone of that material
style.shading: 3 tones + 1 highlight per material, light from the upper left

layers.name: head_back
layers.what: hair or cloth falling behind the body (from the head set)

layers.name: body
layers.what: bare body: skin + base underwear, legs, torso, far arm, neck. The motion lives here; shared by every class of the build

layers.name: outfit
layers.what: the class's clothes for this frame, fitted to body; hides body where it covers

layers.name: head
layers.what: lego head: face, hair, mask; placed at head.point

layers.name: near_arm
layers.what: the arm nearest the viewer (skin); z per frame (nearArmZ)

layers.name: outfit_arm
layers.what: sleeve / glove on the near arm; same z as near_arm

head.attach: head.point is the top centre of the neck; the head PNG's own pivot (heads/<character>/pivot.json) lands on it; the head covers the top 2 px of the neck

pose.crownY: int, top opaque row of the head as placed
